value_text: The HRSG stack height is DP-CASE-0043 as approved in the EIA; the Owner's draft contract text differs and the EIA governs (TQ round of ALP-OWN-ENV-001). The stack foundation, structure and flue gas sampling levels are designed to this height. The dispersion confirmation with the final GT flue gas data is to be issued before the stack design is frozen.
